# Child Artifact Template

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `artifact_id` | `string` | Yes | Unique deterministic identifier for the child artifact |
| `simplest_design` | `string` | Yes | Description of the simplest high-craft approach selected |
| `verification_status` | `enum(PASS,FAIL)` | Yes | Outcome of standalone verification checklist |
